nodes.title: Compile shared contracts and establish isolated module ownership
validation: Compile the exact split-assembly signature surface, extended positive Fluent consumers and FND-05/06 negative generic cases.
Execute FND-01..12 native identity/snapshot/invocation tests; no missing implementation may be represented as a passing stub.
Run worker.py check-index and verify the fixed project/reference/friend-assembly map.

nodes.title: SQL types and typed parameter identities
validation: Run tests/Orm/Types/verify.py including TYP-01..10 and fixed Define/Nullable/Unicode scalar facet cases.
Native tests preserve SQL identity, nullable values, immutable snapshots and deterministic checked conversions.
Inspect pure assembly closure: no Dapper/provider/Roslyn or hidden runtime type discovery.

nodes.title: Immutable relational queries and typed projections
validation: Run tests/Orm/Query/verify.py with immutable clause, scope, projection and dynamic-record fixtures.
Compile scalar/typed-row/DTO projection APIs; test Limit versus LimitLiteral and expected type mismatch diagnostics.
Verify final query handles carry captured sidecars separately from node graphs/templates.

nodes.title: Typed expressions, predicates and SQL truth semantics
validation: Run tests/Orm/Expressions/verify.py and EXP-01..12 including all SQL three-valued truth combinations.
Compile concrete operand/row/CASE overloads and negative mismatches; verify fixed aggregate descriptors/conversion IDs.
Real SQL outcomes remain separate oracle/integration gates, not inferred from a local evaluator.

nodes.title: Typed mutation semantics and returning projections
validation: Run tests/Orm/Dml/verify.py with DML-01..12, typed Set/Values/Returning and AllRows guards.
Verify row-major occurrence order, old-row assignment semantics and operation-specific native RETURNING failures.
Compile Mutation/ReturningMutation rendering and Execute/query terminal seams; no discarded returned rows.

nodes.title: CTEs, set operations and window coordination
validation: Run tests/Orm/Relational/verify.py with REL-01..12 and exact scalar/CTE/window overloads.
Preserve set grouping/recursive visibility/correlation and reject invalid frames or unproved SQLite scalar cardinality.
Supply deterministic real-row cases for four-profile Integration; pure tests do not accept server behavior.

nodes.title: Pure SQL rendering and capability evaluation
validation: Run tests/Orm/Rendering/verify.py and RENDER-01..15 against real common language/types and contract dialect fakes.
Native core-only consumer checks exact SQL/occurrence/result/fingerprint, list-arity errors and concurrent isolation.
Validate Profile.Rules dispatch, unknown/altered profile rejection and explicit declared-SQL boundary.

nodes.title: PostgreSQL SQL profile
validation: Run PostgreSql dialect packet local pure/native cases and exact SQL/layout fixtures.
Verify numbered occurrence binding, conflict/returning/CTE/set/window semantics and every rejected capability.
Accept actual pure nested/advanced lowering dependencies; live PostgreSQL results are independently required in Integration.

nodes.title: SQLite SQL profile
validation: Run SQLite dialect pure/native cases, including literal scalar cardinality proof and unqualified RETURNING.
Reject exact decimal arithmetic/aggregate semantics not preserved by canonical TEXT transport; verify DQS/profile requirements.
Compare SQL/layout fixtures and the native SQLite integration lane at its actual runtime version.

nodes.title: MySQL SQL profile
validation: Run MySQL8.4 pure/native fixtures including conflict policy, assignment dependencies and unsupported RETURNING.
Verify exact modes, placeholder occurrence order and ordered window JSON collection lowering.
Require independent MySQL live results; MariaDB passing is not a substitute.

nodes.title: MariaDB SQL profile
validation: Run MariaDB11.8 pure/native fixtures with its own capabilities/modes and returning support.
Verify JSON aggregation byte guard, empty collections and dedicated error envelope without session SET.
Require independent MariaDB live results and declared budget/cell codec cases.

nodes.title: Neutral schema model and deterministic inputs
validation: Run bash tests/Orm/Schema/check.sh with exact version1 portable model, canonical JSON, naming/filter/override cases.
Compile portable model/format/emitter source for net11 and netstandard2.0 without cross-target runtime references.
Reject duplicate/unresolved/invalid identity and preserve explicit external filtered foreign-key targets.

nodes.title: Explicit local schema acquisition workflow
validation: Run offline check.sh plus four explicitly selected provider acquisition lanes from ORM-SCHEMA-TOOL.
Validate acquire/validate/generate exit codes, atomic outputs and exactly-once SchemaSnapshotTransform.Apply.
Compile and natively run generated source; ordinary build never opens a database or loads arbitrary application codecs.

nodes.title: Reuse Dapper.AOT Runtime with exact layout and lifetime adapters
validation: Run tests/Orm/Execution/check.py --mode managed and --mode native using the actual pinned Dapper runtime and EX fault matrix.
Verify preflight/lease/consumption, command-local cleanup, primary exceptions, stream ownership and exact Timeout semantics.
Compile all mature factory endpoints and test scalar/closed Row/DynamicRecord/static custom mapping without fallback.

nodes.title: Generate mature row factories and explicit final-consumer registration roots
validation: Run bash tests/Orm/Generation/check.sh with exact ORMGEN positive/negative diagnostic and portable-host cases.
Run native final-consumer roots for cross-assembly DTOs/closed Rows, nullable/init/record and strict mapping wrappers.
Inspect generated code/analyzer private closure; physical and incremental schema generation cannot duplicate declarations.

nodes.title: Npgsql execution and schema adapter
validation: Run Providers/PostgreSql/check.py managed/native with KORDA_TEST_POSTGRES and exact profile/catalog fixtures.
Test closed scalar/JSONB/array/range codecs, cancellation/timeout/transactions and resource reuse.
Require typed parameter occurrence order, preflight validation and native DTO mapping; no dynamic JSON/unmapped-type fallback.

nodes.title: Microsoft.Data.Sqlite execution and schema adapter
validation: Run Providers/Sqlite/check.py --mode managed and --mode native with disposable local databases.
Verify storage classes/canonical types/DQS flags, nullability, busy timeout, transactions and owned/borrowed cleanup.
Do not claim in-flight sqlite3_step cancellation; inspect exact driver-native package closure.

nodes.title: MySqlConnector execution and schema adapter
validation: Run Providers/MySql/check.py for both mysql-8.4 and mariadb-11.8 native profiles and separate connection environment inputs.
Verify unsigned/decimal/temporal/JSON codecs, modes, catalog metadata, cancellation/timeout and subsequent reuse.
Reject family/version/mode or codec mismatch before execution and retain separate family evidence.

nodes.title: Implement explicit neutral advanced types and closed conversions
validation: Run exact advanced-type packet tests for immutable neutral JSON/array/range/enum/domain and temporal descriptors.
Compile positive/negative operations and checked read/write conversions; preserve SQL NULL versus JSON null.
Verify each dialect capability and explicit TYPE diagnostics; provider transport is accepted by its own leaf.

nodes.title: Implement logical and physical nested shapes with bounded static decoders
validation: Run nested pure/native decoder/presence/budget/ordering fixtures and complete logical/physical range checks.
Verify exact parent-generated child reads, relative ordinals, one outer Tokenize and bounded shared JSON-reader recursion.
Accept actual renderer/generator/advanced dependencies; Integration executes all four SQL encodings and truncation cases.

nodes.title: Optional SQL parsing and translation module
validation: Run optional parser lexer/Pratt/scoping/metadata/returning fixtures with exact source locations and diagnostic codes.
Require complete token consumption and safe bound-value construction; unsupported syntax never becomes raw SQL fallback.
Compile checked Builder/ReturningMutation/query APIs against actual Schema/language/render modules; exclude parser from mandatory initial package.

nodes.title: Maintain source-linked SQL semantic cases and the jOOQ oracle
validation: Run tests/Orm/Conformance/verify.py with closed JSON schema, canonical fixture and intentionally perturbed negative cases.
Explicitly regenerate selected jOOQ references using fixed Maven SHA256 inputs; ordinary corpus checks stay offline.
Compare ordered total-order rows or multisets correctly; preserve NULL/order/cardinality/occurrence distinctions.

nodes.title: Integrate independently selected product validation
validation: Run existing check-index, Tooling unittest, impact and worker commands with actual temporary Git fixtures CI-01..21.
Verify source/test/metadata ownership, linked generator inputs, provider-specific services and no Markdown-triggered product builds.
Exercise exact owned NuGet DAG staging/validation with target-only publication and unchanged legacy package policy.

nodes.title: Consume seven exact packages with verified owned dependency closure
validation: Build/inspect seven fixed nupkgs through NW_PACKAGE/NW_VERSION/NW_FEED/NW_INPUTS and declared dependency-feed protocol.
Restore exact owned/external closure into isolated caches and run each native or explicitly host-only consumer.
Verify no duplicated Execution/provider leakage, analyzer private load closure, notices/XML/API and multi-provider coexistence.

nodes.title: Compile and document exact local development workflows
validation: Run samples/orm/check.sh --all for exact render, DTO, schema, nested and provider profile cases from ORM-DOCS.
Verify XML/signatures/defaults/cancellation/nullability and generated/manual mapping examples against accepted source.
Package acceptance reruns these examples from exact candidate archives; documentation alone grants no product support.

nodes.title: Compose real modules and validate each database profile
validation: Execute separate native postgres-18/sqlite-3.45/mysql-8.4/mariadb-11.8 lanes against actual modules and exact packages.
Require canonical typed optional/list/join/aggregate/DML/nested/advanced/lifetime cases and negative controls.
Record native/compiler/server versions and remaining excluded cells; no skip is relabelled as full success.

nodes.title: Measure complete public paths against fixed comparable budgets
validation: Use fixed comparable public-path workload/protocol and frozen overhead/allocation/value-isolation budgets.
Run two independent process campaigns with seven rotated rounds; preserve distributions and explicit invalid-measurement outcome.
Separate DSL/render/bind/map/end-to-end and network noise; no benchmark in ordinary document CI.

nodes.title: Independently accept the new product candidate
validation: Independent reviewer executes ACCEPT-API/PURE/PARAM/NULL/MAP/EMPTY/RESOURCE/ONCE/GEN/FOUR/NESTED/PACK/CI/PERF.
Reconcile exact source/package/provenance/feature evidence and resolve every blocker/major before accepting.
Record accepted-for-cutover-review, changes-required or measurement-unresolved; never merge/publish automatically.

nodes.title: Perform an explicitly authorized product migration
validation: Require accepted candidate and a concrete authorized consumer/file manifest before changing existing entry points.
Run CUT-01..10 side-by-side business cases with separate write fixtures, exact packages and rollback rehearsal.
Apply fixed package coexistence policy; retain old implementations and stop before retirement.

nodes.title: Remove only the obsolete implementation after cutover
validation: Require reviewed current-blob removal manifest, completed cutover and explicit deletion authorization.
Run RET-01..10 dependency/native/package/link/retained-consumer checks on only affected closure.
Preserve shared assets/notices/history/prior releases; stop on any unexplained surviving consumer.
